reviews.text: Giovanni, thank you for the rating and trust in our service.
They have several specialties. I take my dog ​​to the ophthalmology clinic, and it's been one of the best in terms of service, diagnosis, and care for my pet.
They take very good care of my kitten!

Terrible service. They told me I had a 10-minute grace period, but at no point did they mention I had to notify them, and they refused to attend to my pet. I do not recommend them; they have no ethics.
I took my dog ​​for an eye exam and they were very attentive. The doctor was patient and kind with my dog ​​and gave me a good explanation. I left very happy.

The oncologists were fantastic, very kind, and the quality of care was excellent. We loved it! 💚

But the internal medicine department was terrible. They have no communication with the other departments, the clinic is inadequate, and there's no proper approach to the pathophysiology or management of patient histories. I don't know why they even have the files.
Also, the administration at the entrance is a mess; they're completely disorganized.

Our dog Baxter needs an urgent oncology evaluation. We scheduled the appointment and were asked for a 50% deposit, which we paid without issue. The appointment was today, Friday; however, the city is in chaos due to protests. We're traveling from Satélite, and there were roadblocks near Naucalli. We reported the delay, which was due to circumstances beyond our control, and the customer service from the person handling the communication channels left much to be desired. First, they threatened my wife, saying she had a certain amount of time to arrive or they wouldn't see our dog (even though we were stuck halfway there). Second, they demanded payment of the remaining 50% of the consultation fee to reschedule, and if we didn't pay, he wouldn't be seen, even though we had already paid the deposit. This obviously doesn't inspire confidence. If they act like this on the first appointment, I don't even want to imagine what it'll be like during the treatment process. Furthermore, we're not interested in having our dog treated at a center where the only thing that matters is money, and the well-being of your dog or pet is clearly a secondary concern. Hopefully, they'll be more conscientious and provide better training for their staff. A little empathy wouldn't hurt.

Terrible service from Dr. Andrea Gallardo S. She doesn't respond to emails, and if there's an emergency, she never answers. I don't recommend her for diabetic dogs or cats. Everything is now handled through WhatsApp, and it's unbelievable that she doesn't share her phone number and much prefers emails that never arrive, let alone are answered. M.

My companion almost died there due to negligence. Obviously, your community manager and employees will try to contradict this or claim that he was treated properly, but it's false; it was nothing more than a money grab.

One of their selling points is that they handle emergency tests, and then they tell you that they still have to send them to a lab for testing, which takes days. To a certain extent, it's understandable. What's not understandable is that they told me those tests were only for emergencies and they didn't even perform them when my poor animal was in mortal danger.

I lost two to three crucial days. I took him to another place I trust, and they managed to save him.

Save yourself this visit in every sense.

And reading other responses you've given, I don't want anything from you at all. I don't want "solutions" or blackmail; I wanted you to protect my companion when I trusted you and fulfilled my part of the transaction. The money that whoever runs this chain of veterinary clinics spent will never come back to me, at least not through you. And I wouldn't go back to you even if you were the last vet clinic available.

No. This review isn't for you; it's for the public. What I want is for other people to know that beyond branding and marketing, there are realities that could be theirs. It's not worth it. Compromising the life of a being that can't communicate isn't worth it.
